propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks mandatory provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) required to detect wrong-environment and privilege-escalation escapes in the evidence contract.

Two past gating failures bypassed the gate: measurements taken in account 579718921998/us-east-2 were recorded as valid for account 896586841071/us-east-1, and bedrock:Converse calls under bedrock:* privilege were offered as proof of a scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant that would have been denied in production.

The current evidence contract demands provenance of the attestation event (change id, vote, timestamp) but nothing about the measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument kind), making it structurally unable to catch environment mismatches or privilege-masking failures.

Deterministic string-based checks cannot audit world state, but forcing measurement provenance into the record as text enables repo-grounded LLM criteria to detect contradictions (declared environment vs in-repo IaC backend).

An [operator-attested] criterion whose evidence comes from simulation or static-analysis cannot be distinguished from live evidence by privilege_posture alone, leaving escape 2b (aws iam simulate-principal-policy returning wrong authorization) invisible in the record.
